books.title: Setting Up A Poultry Farming Business
books.author: Lagos State Employment Trust Fund (LSETF)
books.freeSourceNote: Free direct PDF, hosted on the official Lagos State Employment Trust Fund site, no signup required
books.verificationMethod: Found via broader search since the founder's own research found no confident free candidate. Hosted directly on lsetf.ng, a real Lagos State Government agency — covers value chain, market analysis, financials, and feed sourcing specifically for the Nigerian market. More institutionally credible than the many 'free ebook' poultry guides found elsewhere, several of which turned out to be paid ($7) products marketed misleadingly as free, or user-uploaded business-plan templates of uncertain origin — both correctly excluded.

notes: Matches the founder's own honest finding — the first profession where Nigeria's content ecosystem is genuinely rich rather than thin. FinReels' edge here is curation and structure, not filling a void.
